description: KIDS FUN UAT parent-journey catalogue (G-T36-3). Realistic searches the primary persona — an East-Vancouver parent with a 2-year-old and a 5-year-old (PRD §10) — actually runs, exercised over the REAL search path (evals/harness.ts → runUat). The harness measures the two launch-gate quality bars the T-36 exit-AC names: benchmark SEARCH SUCCESS (KPI #1, relevant non-empty top-10, ≥80%) and useful result DENSITY (KPI #2, ≥3 realistic options, ≥70%), plus zero-result RECOVERY (KPI #6) and the PRD §9 SC#4 no-empty-screen invariant. 'benchmark' journeys are the flagship-class searches the launch benchmark is defined on and that the shipped catalogue supports densely (the ≥80%/≥70% bar is asserted over this tier on the fixture path); 'realistic' journeys broaden coverage and are measured + logged honestly. See evals/scenarios/uat.test.ts and docs/uat-harness.md for how the SAME journeys perform over the (currently thin) live ingested catalogue.
clock: FIXTURE_NOW = 2026-07-13T19:00:00Z (America/Vancouver reference); winter journeys are correctly out-of-season at this instant.

journeys.label: open gym near East Van
journeys.persona: Rainy Tuesday morning — parent wants an indoor drop-in gym close to home for a 2yo and 5yo.

journeys.label: drop-in gym near East Van
journeys.persona: Parent uses everyday language ('drop-in gym') rather than the catalogue term — alias expansion must still find the open-gym family.

journeys.label: gym time near East Van
journeys.persona: Another parent phrasing ('gym time') for the same intent — coverage of the open-gym alias set.

journeys.label: free things to do near East Van
journeys.persona: Budget-conscious weekend browse — 'what free activities are near me right now?' A broad discovery journey; any launch category is on-topic.

journeys.label: what's on near East Van (browse, no keyword)
journeys.persona: Parent opens the app with no specific plan and just browses everything nearby — the empty-query discovery path.

journeys.label: family swim near East Van
journeys.persona: Hot afternoon — parent wants a leisure/family public swim both kids can join, close to home.

journeys.label: swimming lessons near East Van
journeys.persona: Parent phrases the aquatic intent as 'swimming lessons' — should still land on public/leisure swim (no lessons product at launch).

journeys.label: toddler storytime
journeys.persona: Library storytime for the 2yo — a low-cost, all-weather staple. Not geo-bound; a parent will travel a little for the right session.

journeys.label: free storytime
journeys.persona: Explicitly free storytime — the honest-cost path (unknown-cost listings must NOT be presented as free).

journeys.label: indoor play for a rainy day near East Van
journeys.persona: Classic rainy-day search — soft-play / indoor playground the little ones can burn energy in; nearby indoor gym play is an acceptable adjacent option.

journeys.label: public skate
journeys.persona: Weekend family skate — the parent will drive across town for ice time, so no near-me radius.

journeys.label: aquarium day out
journeys.persona: A bigger day-out attraction for both kids — the Aquarium as its own category (never mixed into swim).

journeys.label: miniature train (Stanley Park)
journeys.persona: Seasonal favourite — the little ones love the mini train; parent searches by the everyday name.

journeys.label: tobogganing near East Van (out of season in July)
journeys.persona: Parent hopefully searches a winter activity in mid-July. There are no confirmed dates — the honest outcome is an out-of-season/expected option + explanation, never a bare empty screen (PRD T-07/T-11, KPI #6).

journeys.label: pottery class near East Van (genuine no-match)
journeys.persona: Parent searches an activity the catalogue simply does not carry at launch. The empty state must name the blocking constraint and suggest relaxations (PRD T-11), not dead-end.
